title: Raise daily transfer limit for Premium customers to €5,000
requestSummary: Premium customers can now transfer up to €5,000 per day (instead of €1,000). Standard customers stay at €1,000. The daily transfer limit is currently a single hardcoded constant with no tier awareness across two repositories.
openQuestions: BLOCKER: Will the fraud threshold (€2,000, FR-2024-17) be raised or made tier-aware for Premium customers? Without this, any single transfer >€2,000 is permanently PENDING_REVIEW regardless of the new limit. [Owner: risk/fraud team — evidence: novabank-api/src/fraud/rules.ts:14]
Should GET /api/limits remain unauthenticated or accept a customer/session token to return the correct tier limit? [Owner: API/security team]
Is there a per-transaction cap separate from the daily cap? None found in either repository — confirm with product.
Are there unknown external consumers of /api/limits beyond novabank-mobile? The cross-repo scan found no static links — verify with other teams.

entryPoints.label: POST /api/transfers
entryPoints.description: HTTP route that executes a money transfer. Calls executeTransfer() which enforces the daily limit. The limit check runs after the fraud gate.

entryPoints.label: GET /api/limits
entryPoints.description: HTTP route returning the daily transfer limit. Currently returns a static { dailyLimit: 1000 } regardless of customer tier. Called by novabank-mobile to display the UI label.

entryPoints.label: TransferScreen (mobile)
entryPoints.description: Mobile screen that validates transfer amount client-side against CLIENT_DAILY_LIMIT (hardcoded 1000) and displays a hardcoded label 'Daily limit: €1,000'.

evidence.snippet: export async function submitTransfer(payload: TransferPayload): Promise<TransferScreenState>

items.label: DAILY_LIMIT = 1000 (single constant, no tier awareness)
items.description: The entire transfer limit system is one constant. Changing it to 5000 would raise the limit for ALL customers, not just Premium. Must be refactored into per-tier limits.

evidence.snippet: // Transfer limits — applies to all customers regardless of tier

items.label: Fraud gate blocks all transfers >€2,000 (FR-2024-17)
items.description: checkFraud() runs as step 1 in executeTransfer, BEFORE the daily limit check (step 2). Any Premium transfer of €2,001–€5,000 will be intercepted here and put in PENDING_REVIEW, making the new limit unreachable without a fraud rule update.

evidence.snippet: * Block transfers above 2000 pending manual review - fraud incident FR-2024-17
// 1. Fraud check — takes priority over all other checks

issues.description: The fraud threshold (€2,000) contradicts the proposed Premium limit (€5,000). Transfers of €2,001–€5,000 will be PENDING_REVIEW, not COMPLETED, for all customers including Premium. Requires risk/fraud team sign-off before PROD-482 can be fully effective.

items.label: AML reporting threshold €3,000 (COMP-7)
items.description: Regulatory requirement: all completed transfers ≥€3,000 appear in the nightly AML report. Raising the Premium limit to €5,000 will increase the volume of AML-reported transfers.

evidence.snippet: // AML nightly report - regulatory requirement COMP-7

items.label: CLIENT_DAILY_LIMIT = 1000 (mobile client-side guard)
items.description: Duplicate hardcoded limit in the mobile app. Added to save API round-trips. If not updated, Premium customers will be blocked on the mobile side even after the backend is fixed.

evidence.snippet: // Client-side limit check to save API calls

issues.description: Same €1,000 limit encoded independently from the backend. Both must be updated atomically or the mobile guard must become API-driven.

items.label: Hardcoded limit string in notification template
items.description: limitInfo() returns a static string '€1,000'. It has 0% test coverage and will silently send wrong limit information after the change.

items.label: Hardcoded UI label 'Daily limit: €1,000' in TransferScreen
items.description: The label shown to the user is a compile-time string constant. Premium users will see the wrong limit until this is made dynamic.

items.label: CustomerTier already in DB schema and getCustomer()
items.description: CustomerRow.tier: 'STANDARD'|'PREMIUM' already exists and getCustomer() is already imported in transferService.ts. No DB migration needed — the tier data is already available at the enforcement point.

items.label: tests/limits.test.ts — 'DAILY_LIMIT is 1000'
items.description: Asserts the constant value is 1000. Will break when the constant is refactored.

items.label: tests/routes.test.ts — 'returns dailyLimit 1000'
items.description: Asserts GET /api/limits returns 1000. Breaks with naive one-liner (confirmed by simulation: 3 tests fail).

items.label: tests/transferService.test.ts — 'rejects when daily limit is exceeded'
items.description: Sends 800+300=1100 total, expects REJECTED. With DAILY_LIMIT=5000 this passes, breaking the test (confirmed by simulation).

evidence.snippet: it("rejects when daily limit is exceeded", async () => {

rows.input: transferService.test.ts — rejects when daily limit is exceeded (800+300)
rows.after: ❌ FAIL (COMPLETED instead of REJECTED — all customers now get 5000)

simulations.rawOutput: 3 failed | 14 passed (17 total). Naive edit raises limit for ALL customers and breaks 3 tests. Fraud gate still blocks amounts >2000.

effortEstimate: 7 files to change across 2 repos, ~60–80 lines. Plus fraud team coordination (blocking).
riskRationale: Two independent hardcoded constants must be updated atomically. A blocking fraud rule contradiction means Premium customers cannot complete single transfers >€2,000 without a separate fraud rule change. Two files with zero coverage (templates.ts, amlReport.ts) will not be caught by existing tests. A naive one-liner breaks 3 tests and makes the change non-tier-aware.

changePlan.action: Coordinate with risk/fraud team to decide how the €2,000 fraud threshold (FR-2024-17) applies to Premium customers.
changePlan.rationale: The fraud gate runs before the limit check and blocks all transfers >€2,000. Without this decision, the new €5,000 Premium limit is effectively unreachable for single transactions.

changePlan.action: Notify compliance team that AML COMP-7 report volume will increase because more Premium transfers will now be ≥€3,000 and appear in the nightly report.
changePlan.rationale: Regulatory requirement COMP-7 — compliance team must sign off before go-live.

changePlan.action: In src/transfers/limits.ts: replace DAILY_LIMIT with STANDARD_DAILY_LIMIT=1000 and PREMIUM_DAILY_LIMIT=5000 (or a getLimitForTier(tier) function).
changePlan.rationale: Single constant must become tier-aware. All callers must be updated in the same PR.

changePlan.action: In src/transfers/transferService.ts: move the getCustomer() call before step 2 (line 33) and apply tier-appropriate limit. Avoid a second DB call — the customer record is already needed.
changePlan.rationale: executeTransfer already has customerId and imports getCustomer. CustomerTier is already in the DB.

changePlan.action: In src/api/routes.ts: update GET /api/limits to accept an optional customerId or tier query parameter and return the tier-appropriate dailyLimit.
changePlan.rationale: Mobile app calls this endpoint to display the limit label and pass it to client-side validation.

changePlan.action: In src/notifications/templates.ts: make limitInfo() accept the limit amount as a parameter.
changePlan.rationale: Current hardcoded string '€1,000' has 0% test coverage and will silently send wrong limit info to Premium customers.

changePlan.action: In novabank-mobile src/transfers/validateTransfer.ts: accept the limit as a parameter instead of using CLIENT_DAILY_LIMIT constant.
changePlan.rationale: Duplicate hardcoded constant was intentional to save API calls, but must now be API-driven or parameterised.

changePlan.action: In novabank-mobile src/screens/TransferScreen.ts: call getLimits() on mount, store the tier-aware limit, render it in the label, pass it to validateTransfer().
changePlan.rationale: Hardcoded label '€1,000' will show wrong information to Premium customers.

changePlan.action: In novabank-mobile src/services/api.ts: update getLimits() return type to match the updated API response shape.
changePlan.rationale: TypeScript type safety — return type will change if backend adds per-tier fields.

changePlan.action: Update all affected tests in both repos. Add PREMIUM-tier test cases. Add coverage for notifications/templates.ts and compliance/amlReport.ts.
changePlan.rationale: 3 existing tests break with the naive edit. notifications/templates.ts and amlReport.ts have 0% coverage and will not catch regressions.
